_comment: SERVER-SIDE FEATURE FLAGS for the TUITEA web shell.
This file is fetched fresh on every launch (network-first, never cached by
the service worker) so a section can be hidden or restored WITHOUT
redeploying the app shell and WITHOUT anybody reinstalling.
Rollback = edit this file, commit. Live in under a minute.
Resolution order for each flag, first match wins:
webBuildStamp selects WHICH COMPILED TUITEA the installed web app boots:
Both are real release builds of the same commit; a viewer downloads one.
A viewer's cohort is whatever they hold in localStorage 'tuitea.cohort'.
'owner' and 'test' are set by opening /app/tuitea/?cohort=owner once.
Everyone else is 'public'. This is a PRESENTATION gate, not a security
boundary — real authorisation lives in the backend, never in this file.
